answer: An attacker hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The bridge schedule is applied in tide and gale publishes each instalment. A payout is split thus 32% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2361 identities would post 3176 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
